author: Jeff Geerling
description:
Timing is everything.

More about Telstra's GNSS timing-related outage:

  - https://hackaday.com/2026/08/27/australias-nationwide-phone-outage-was-an-embarrassing-failure/
  - https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-09-02/telstra-outage-review-findings-known-network-issues-not-priority/107106588

Some of the projects I built, contributed to, or used:

  - Jimmy Paputto GNSS HAT: https://github.com/jimmypaputto/gnsshat
  - Densitron LCD: https://github.com/geerlingguy/densitron-lcd
  - Time-Pi Fan Control: https://github.com/geerlingguy/time-pi/tree/master/fan-control
  - Time-Pi Chrony Dashboard: https://github.com/geerlingguy/time-pi/tree/master/chrony-dashboard
  - TrueTime Pi Mounting Bracket: https://www.printables.com/model/1832259-truetime-pi-mounting-bracket
  - Right-angle HDMI and USB-C Adapter: https://deskpi.com/products/deskpi-kl-p24-raspberry-pi-adapter-board

And here's the EEVBlog forum thread on the TrueTime XL-AK: https://www.eevblog.com/forum/projects/symmetricom-truetime-
